blind_read: The monkey hammered the keyboard until it steamed, recoiled, blew on it and resumed with one careful finger.

evidence.observation: Both hands drop at once and steam rises. The sudden raised fists and clenched teeth read as a reaction to the keyboard, whose case stays still.
A single index finger rises before touching the right side of the key bed. Both coat colors preserve the warm hand, keyboard and white breath puff.
